evidence.detail: Comment explicitly labels z-index:3 on .badge-holder a hack; the badge appears before <a class=item> in the DOM so it needs elevation to be clickable

{{#badge}}
...
{{/badge}} appears before in the li, causing the z-index stacking problem
.badge-holder has position:relative so .badge (position:absolute) anchors to it; z-index:3 lifts it above the following item link

triage.fix_sketch: In decksite/templates/menu.mustache, move the {{#badge}}…{{/badge}} block to after the <a class="item"> element. In shared_web/static/css/pd.css, add position:relative to the <li> (or the enclosing element), remove position:relative from .badge-holder, and remove the z-index:3 hack — the badge will then position absolutely relative to the li and paint above the item link naturally by DOM order.
triage.notes: Confidence medium because the badge positioning interacts with the dropdown submenu logic (css comment on pd.css:2664 warns menu items need static positioning for dropdowns); visual regression testing is advisable before merging.
